verdict.rationale: Azure ships a well-documented, cross-platform official CLI (azure-cli) with scripting support, tab-completion, JMESPath output querying, and container/Cloud Shell availability, and community input confirms most Azure tasks can be done via CLI. missing for 10: no evidence of AI-agent-specific CLI features (e.g., agent-friendly structured output modes beyond JMESPath, or CLI extensions tailored for autonomous agents) and no independent hands-on benchmark of CLI reliability for automation.
